summary: Mixed day led by retail market growth outlook and Reliance capital plans. India's home/household market projected at USD 260 billion by 2030; Reliance pursues $1 billion securitization as second bond sale in three weeks.

bullets.text: India's home and household market projected to reach USD 260 billion by 2030, with durables/appliances growing from USD 66B (2025) to USD 95B (2030).
Reliance plans $1 billion securitization deal, its second bond sale in three weeks, in major borrowing push.
Calcutta High Court dismisses plea flagging age discrepancy in BJP candidate Hasirani Rath's affidavit.
Zigly targets Rs 100 crore revenue in FY2026-27 with 60 centres expansion and vet-care service deepening.
Flipkart's Ekart adds 14 million cu ft warehouse space and 750 pincodes; storage capacity up 50%, peak processing up 30% ahead of festive season.
